# CoUI

> CoUI is a cross-platform UI component library for Dart: the same components, with the same named-properties API and the same design tokens, render on Flutter (mobile/desktop) and on the web via Jaspr.

- Packages: `coui_flutter` (Flutter widgets), `coui_web` (Jaspr components), `coui_core` (platform-neutral contracts, styles and design tokens shared by both).
- Import one barrel per platform: `package:coui_flutter/coui_flutter.dart` or `package:coui_web/coui_web.dart`.
- Visual overrides go through a single `xxxStyle: CoreXxxStyle?` parameter per component; semantic choices such as `variant` and `size` are plain parameters.
- The linked documentation pages are written in Korean; component names, parameters and code samples are English.

- [All components](https://coui.cocode.im/components-overview): Every component, grouped by category

## Components: Control

Buttons, toggles, and interactive controls.

- [Button](https://coui.cocode.im/components/button): Clickable button
- [Command](https://coui.cocode.im/components/command): Command palette
- [FAB](https://coui.cocode.im/components/fab): Floating action button
- [Hover](https://coui.cocode.im/components/hover): Hover effect wrapper
- [ThemeController](https://coui.cocode.im/components/theme-controller): Theme picker swatches
- [Filter](https://coui.cocode.im/components/filter): Segmented filter control
- [ToggleGroup](https://coui.cocode.im/components/toggle-group): Grouped toggle with a raised chosen segment
- [CommandSearch](https://coui.cocode.im/components/command-search): Command palette trigger

## Components: Form

Form inputs and data entry components.

- [TextField](https://coui.cocode.im/components/text-field): Text input field
- [TextArea](https://coui.cocode.im/components/text-area): Multi-line text
- [RichEditor](https://coui.cocode.im/components/rich-editor): Markdown post / comment composer
- [Select](https://coui.cocode.im/components/select): Dropdown select
- [Checkbox](https://coui.cocode.im/components/checkbox): Select one or more options, with an indeterminate state
- [Toggle](https://coui.cocode.im/components/toggle): On/off toggle
- [Slider](https://coui.cocode.im/components/slider): Range slider
- [DatePicker](https://coui.cocode.im/components/date-picker): Date selector
- [TimePicker](https://coui.cocode.im/components/time-picker): Hour, minute, and second picker
- [ColorPicker](https://coui.cocode.im/components/color-picker): Pick and edit a color
- [AutoComplete](https://coui.cocode.im/components/autocomplete): Auto-suggestions
- [InputOtp](https://coui.cocode.im/components/input-otp): OTP input
- [RadioGroup](https://coui.cocode.im/components/radio-group): Radio selection
- [MultipleChoice](https://coui.cocode.im/components/multiple-choice): Single-select option group
- [StarRating](https://coui.cocode.im/components/star-rating): Star rating
- [Range](https://coui.cocode.im/components/range): Dual-handle range slider
- [ItemPicker](https://coui.cocode.im/components/item-picker): Searchable item picker
- [MultiAnswerCard](https://coui.cocode.im/components/multi-answer-card): Selectable answer card
- [OptionItem](https://coui.cocode.im/components/option-item): One choosable row of a list of options — a check for single, a checkbox for multiple
- [OptionList](https://coui.cocode.im/components/option-list): Option list — OptionItems stacked in one column
- [BottomSheet](https://coui.cocode.im/components/bottom-sheet): Bottom sheet — the panel that rises from the bottom of a phone screen: handle, title, content and a bottom bar
- [FormattedInput](https://coui.cocode.im/components/formatted-input): Masked / segmented input
- [NumberInput](https://coui.cocode.im/components/number-input): Stepper-style number field
- [ObjectInput](https://coui.cocode.im/components/object-input): Key-value field input
- [PhoneInput](https://coui.cocode.im/components/phone-input): Phone number
- [ChipInput](https://coui.cocode.im/components/chip-input): Tag input
- [SwitchField](https://coui.cocode.im/components/switch-field): Switch toggle
- [Drag](https://coui.cocode.im/components/drag): Drag, drop and reorder primitives
- [Sortable](https://coui.cocode.im/components/sortable): Drag to reorder
- [Fieldset](https://coui.cocode.im/components/fieldset): Field grouping
- [FileInput](https://coui.cocode.im/components/file-input): File upload
- [Form](https://coui.cocode.im/components/form): Form container
- [FormLabel](https://coui.cocode.im/components/form-label): Form field label
- [FormField](https://coui.cocode.im/components/form-field): Form field wrapper (used inside Form)
- [Formatter](https://coui.cocode.im/components/formatter): Input formatter factories
- [Validated](https://coui.cocode.im/components/validated): Validation ring wrapper
- [ValidatorHint](https://coui.cocode.im/components/validator-hint): Validation message

## Components: Layout

Structure, containers, and layout components.

- [Accordion](https://coui.cocode.im/components/accordion): Expandable sections
- [Collapsible](https://coui.cocode.im/components/collapsible): Collapsible panel
- [Disclosure](https://coui.cocode.im/components/disclosure): Native <details> section that opens without JavaScript
- [Card](https://coui.cocode.im/components/card): Slot-based content card
- [CardImage](https://coui.cocode.im/components/card-image): Card with an image plus title/subtitle
- [Table](https://coui.cocode.im/components/table): Data table
- [Stepper](https://coui.cocode.im/components/stepper): Step indicator
- [Steps](https://coui.cocode.im/components/steps): Steps display
- [StepItem](https://coui.cocode.im/components/step-item): One step row — the unit Steps (list) stacks
- [Tree](https://coui.cocode.im/components/tree): Tree view
- [Resizable](https://coui.cocode.im/components/resizable): Resizable panel
- [ScrollArea](https://coui.cocode.im/components/scroll-area): Styled scrollable viewport
- [FadeScroll](https://coui.cocode.im/components/fade-scroll): Scroll edge fade wrapper
- [ScrollableClient](https://coui.cocode.im/components/scrollable-client): 2D scrollable viewport with offset-aware builder
- [OverflowMarquee](https://coui.cocode.im/components/overflow-marquee): Scrolling marquee for overflow text
- [Stacks](https://coui.cocode.im/components/stack-layout): Layered children with per-layer offset
- [StageContainer](https://coui.cocode.im/components/stage-container): Responsive container with breakpoint padding
- [Window](https://coui.cocode.im/components/window): Window manager with drag, resize, and snap
- [WindowPanel](https://coui.cocode.im/components/window-panel): Window-style panel with title bar + controls
- [DraggablePanel](https://coui.cocode.im/components/draggable-panel): Floating, draggable, edge-docking tool palette
- [Join](https://coui.cocode.im/components/join): Join elements
- [Basic](https://coui.cocode.im/components/basic): Slot-based row layout
- [Frame](https://coui.cocode.im/components/frame): Layout primitive mirroring a Figma frame 1:1
- [Hidden](https://coui.cocode.im/components/hidden): Collapse toggle wrapper with fade + size animation
- [Listing](https://coui.cocode.im/components/listing): Row-based list container with smart column grow
- [SwipeActions](https://coui.cocode.im/components/swipe-actions): List row that reveals actions when swiped sideways
- [Gap](https://coui.cocode.im/components/gap): Spacing utility
- [Mask](https://coui.cocode.im/components/mask): Clip content to a shape
- [MediaQuery](https://coui.cocode.im/components/media-query): Responsive visibility by breakpoint
- [Breakpoint](https://coui.cocode.im/components/breakpoint): Current viewport tier accessor (mobile/tablet/desktop)
- [ResponsiveContainer](https://coui.cocode.im/components/responsive-container): Centred, max-width layout wrapper
- [ResponsiveGrid](https://coui.cocode.im/components/responsive-grid): CSS-Grid-based responsive grid with col/row span
- [ResponsiveRowColumn](https://coui.cocode.im/components/responsive-row-column): Row↔Column layout that flips at a breakpoint tier
- [Scaffold](https://coui.cocode.im/components/scaffold): Screen layout structure
- [PageHeader](https://coui.cocode.im/components/page-header): Page head — eyebrow, title and actions
- [PanelHeader](https://coui.cocode.im/components/panel-header): Panel head — a title and one trailing action
- [BottomActionBar](https://coui.cocode.im/components/bottom-action-bar): Bottom action bar — the primary and secondary actions at the foot of a screen

## Components: Navigation

Navigation and wayfinding components.

- [AppBar](https://coui.cocode.im/components/app-bar): Application bar with leading / title / trailing clusters
- [Dock](https://coui.cocode.im/components/dock): Bottom navigation bar
- [Tabs](https://coui.cocode.im/components/tabs): Tab navigation
- [TabPane](https://coui.cocode.im/components/tab-pane): Tabbed content panels
- [NavigationBar](https://coui.cocode.im/components/navigation-bar): Bottom nav bar
- [NavigationBarItem](https://coui.cocode.im/components/navigation-bar-item): Navigation item — one sidebar row, usable outside the bar
- [Sidebar](https://coui.cocode.im/components/sidebar): Sidebar — side navigation with identity, search, rows and the account
- [Breadcrumb](https://coui.cocode.im/components/breadcrumb): Breadcrumb trail
- [Pagination](https://coui.cocode.im/components/pagination): Page navigation
- [Switcher](https://coui.cocode.im/components/switcher): View switcher
- [IndexedSwitcher](https://coui.cocode.im/components/indexed-switcher): Destination switcher that keeps every view

## Components: Menu

Menus and contextual actions.

- [Menu](https://coui.cocode.im/components/menu): Menu list
- [MenuItem](https://coui.cocode.im/components/menu-item): A single menu row — the unit Menu and Select lay out
- [ContextMenu](https://coui.cocode.im/components/context-menu): Right-click menu
- [DropdownMenu](https://coui.cocode.im/components/dropdown-menu): Dropdown actions
- [Menubar](https://coui.cocode.im/components/menubar): App menu bar
- [ToolbarGroup](https://coui.cocode.im/components/toolbar-group): Related toolbar controls on one shared surface
- [NavigationMenu](https://coui.cocode.im/components/navigation-menu): Horizontal mega-menu

## Components: Infra

Low-level building-block components.

- [Clickable](https://coui.cocode.im/components/clickable): Interaction wrapper
- [FocusOutline](https://coui.cocode.im/components/focus-outline): Focus ring around a control
- [OutlinedContainer](https://coui.cocode.im/components/outlined-container): Bordered container box
- [SubfocusScope](https://coui.cocode.im/components/subfocus): Keyboard focus traversal scope
- [ScrollViewInterceptor](https://coui.cocode.im/components/scrollview): Desktop scroll interception
- [Popup](https://coui.cocode.im/components/popup): Floating panel container
- [Scrollbar](https://coui.cocode.im/components/scrollbar): Themed scrollbar

## Blocks

- [All blocks](https://coui.cocode.im/blocks): Page-section shells composed from components
- [Hero](https://coui.cocode.im/blocks/hero): The hero at the top of a page. Centered copy, or copy and media side by side.
- [Footer](https://coui.cocode.im/blocks/footer): The footer at the bottom of a page, with nav sections & a legal block
